# Design Language Atlas

> A field index of design languages: visual traditions from art, craft, architecture and graphic design, with a deep section on Türkiye and Anatolia. Each entry has its feel, its materials, a four-colour palette and names to look up next.

Source: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/  ·  Updated: 2026-10-04

## Göbekli Tepe & Neolithic Anatolia

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Era & style
- Era: c. 9600–6000 BCE
- Palette: #c9b48f, #8a7457, #e6dcc6, #a2452e
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#gobekli-tepe-and-neolithic-anatolia

The oldest monumental art on earth: T-shaped stone pillars carved with foxes, boars and vultures.

Traits: Limestone, low relief, rings of pillars, ochre wall paintings at Çatalhöyük.

Look up: Göbekli Tepe pillars, Çatalhöyük murals, Karahan Tepe

## Hittite relief

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Era & style
- Era: c. 1600–1180 BCE
- Palette: #5e5a54, #8c7b62, #b08d57, #2f2d2a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#hittite-relief

Processions of gods cut into living rock, heavy and certain.

Traits: Basalt and rock-face relief, sun discs, lions, bronze standards.

Look up: Yazılıkaya, Alaca Höyük sun discs, Lion Gate at Hattusa

## Byzantine mosaic

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Movement
- Era: c. 500–1450
- Palette: #c9a13a, #1d3557, #6b2d5c, #e8dcc0
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#byzantine-mosaic

Gold tesserae that glitter in candlelight; flat, frontal, sacred figures.

Traits: Gold ground, glass tesserae, deep blues and purples, light that moves as you walk.

Look up: Hagia Sophia mosaics, Chora (Kariye) mosaics, Ravenna

## Cappadocian rock-cut

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: c. 300–1200
- Palette: #d9c2a0, #b5835a, #3e5c76, #f1e6d2
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#cappadocian-rock-cut

Rooms carved into soft volcanic rock and painted in the dark.

Traits: Tuff stone, cave interiors, small openings, frescoes in ochre and blue.

Look up: Göreme Open Air Museum, Dark Church, Derinkuyu

## Seljuk stone geometry

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 12th–13th c.
- Palette: #c8a27c, #7a5a3e, #2f8f9d, #1a1a1a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#seljuk-stone-geometry

Austere stone buildings with explosive carved portals.

Traits: Cut stone, deep relief, star polygons, muqarnas, turquoise and black tile inside.

Look up: Divriği Great Mosque, Sivas Gök Medrese, Karatay Medrese, Sultanhanı

## İznik çini

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: c. 1480–1620
- Palette: #1f4f9c, #2aa6a1, #c8372d, #f7f5ef
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#iznik-cini

The Ottoman flower garden in glazed tile: tulips, carnations, saz leaves.

Traits: Cobalt, turquoise, raised tomato red and sage green on brilliant white.

Look up: Rüstem Paşa Mosque, Topkapı Circumcision Room

## Saz style

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 16th c.
- Palette: #1b1b1b, #6c7a3a, #c9b78f, #efe8d8
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#saz-style

Ink drawings of long serrated leaves swirling around dragons and birds.

Traits: Fine line, movement, hybrid creatures, often black ink alone.

Look up: Şahkulu, saz yolu drawings, Topkapı albums

## Hat: Ottoman calligraphy

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 15th–20th c.
- Palette: #111111, #b8923a, #efe3c8, #7a1f1f
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#hat-ottoman-calligraphy

Writing treated like architecture: letters stacked and balanced like a building.

Traits: Thuluth and celî scripts, istif compositions, burnished paper, black and gold.

Look up: Şeyh Hamdullah, Hafız Osman, Mustafa Rakım, celî levha

## Tuğra

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 14th–19th c.
- Palette: #1d2b6b, #c9a13a, #f2e8d0, #111111
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#tugra

The sultan's signature, and arguably the first logo system.

Traits: Tall verticals, sweeping loops, gold on lapis, one mark on every document.

Look up: Tuğra of Süleyman the Magnificent, Ottoman fermans

## Tezhip: illumination

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 15th–19th c.
- Palette: #c9a13a, #1f3b8a, #b0412e, #f3ead6
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#tezhip-illumination

Gold and lapis ornament framing a page, dense yet perfectly ordered.

Traits: Rumi and hatayi motifs, gold leaf, lapis blue, symmetrical margins.

Look up: Kara Memi, Topkapı manuscripts

## Ottoman miniature

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 16th–18th c.
- Palette: #3b6e8f, #c4473a, #d9b45a, #eae1c8
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ottoman-miniature

Flat, bird's-eye storytelling: whole cities and festivals seen from above.

Traits: No perspective, mapped space, many small figures, bright mineral colours.

Look up: Matrakçı Nasuh city maps, Levnî's Surname-i Vehbi, Nakkaş Osman

## Ottoman court textiles

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 15th–17th c.
- Palette: #a3202b, #c9a13a, #1f3b5a, #f1e6cf
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ottoman-court-textiles

Kaftans and velvets with huge, bold motifs. Çintemani reads like modern graphics.

Traits: Çintemani (three dots and tiger stripes), ogival lattices, crimson silk and gold.

Look up: Topkapı kaftans, çatma velvet, kemha

## Ebru: paper marbling

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 15th c.–today
- Palette: #2c4f86, #c0392b, #e3b23c, #f4efe4
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ebru-paper-marbling

Colour floated on water and lifted onto paper; each sheet is one moment.

Traits: Fluid veins, combed patterns, flowers drawn in liquid.

Look up: Necmeddin Okyay, Mustafa Düzgünman

## Karagöz shadow theatre

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 16th c.–today
- Palette: #e8dcb5, #b23a2a, #2a6f6a, #1a1410
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#karagoz-shadow-theatre

Coloured, translucent figures pressed against a lit screen: comedy in shadow and light.

Traits: Backlit camel hide, saturated translucent colour, bold silhouettes, the white perde.

Look up: Hacivat and Karagöz figures, gölge oyunu

## Kilim & Anatolian weaving

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: centuries–today
- Palette: #a2322b, #23395b, #6b4a2e, #d9a93a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#kilim-and-anatolian-weaving

Geometric motifs that each carry a meaning: fertility, protection, the wolf's mouth.

Traits: Elibelinde, koçboynuzu, göz, kurt ağzı; madder red, indigo, walnut brown, weld yellow.

Look up: Konya kilims, Vakıflar Carpet Museum

## Oya & yazma

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: centuries–today
- Palette: #c64b4b, #4f7a4a, #f2e6d6, #2b2b4a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#oya-and-yazma

Tiny needle-lace flowers edging a scarf; hand-printed woodblock cloth.

Traits: Miniature 3D flowers, block-printed cotton, soft reds and greens.

Look up: İğne oyası, Tokat yazma

## Mimar Sinan

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 16th c.
- Palette: #8d8f91, #d8cfbf, #f2ede3, #3c4a57
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#mimar-sinan

Domes cascading into half-domes, with interiors full of even, calm light.

Traits: Lead-grey domes, pencil minarets, stone, hundreds of windows.

Look up: Süleymaniye, Selimiye, Şehzade Mosque

## Hammam

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 14th c.–today
- Palette: #e9e4da, #b8b2a6, #6d6a63, #f7f3e8
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#hammam

Marble and steam under a dome pierced with small glass stars of daylight.

Traits: Fil gözü skylights, heated göbek taşı, warm marble, light shafts in mist.

Look up: Çemberlitaş Hamamı, Kılıç Ali Paşa Hamamı

## Ottoman wooden house

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 17th–19th c.
- Palette: #8b5e3c, #e8dcc6, #6e7f80, #3b2f2a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ottoman-wooden-house

Timber houses with upper floors leaning over the street and a hall at the centre.

Traits: Cumba bays, kafes lattices, sofa plan, painted ceilings; Sedad Hakkı Eldem's modern version.

Look up: Safranbolu houses, Bosphorus yalı, Sedad Hakkı Eldem

## Tulip Era

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Era & style
- Era: 1718–1730
- Palette: #d97a8a, #8fb38a, #f1e3c6, #3f6c8c
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#tulip-era

Ottoman taste goes soft and festive: fountains, gardens, flowers in vases.

Traits: Pastel paint, floral panels, Baroque curves meeting Ottoman ornament.

Look up: Fountain of Ahmed III, Levnî

## Mevlevi sema

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: 13th c.–today
- Palette: #f4f1ea, #b58d5b, #3a2f28, #7b6e64
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#mevlevi-sema

The whirling ceremony: white robes, one turning circle, the ney's long breath.

Traits: White, felt sikke hats, circular motion, stillness inside movement.

Look up: Mevlana Museum Konya, ney

## Hüzün

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: 19th c.–today
- Palette: #2b2e33, #8a8d90, #d6d2c8, #5a6b78
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#huzun

Istanbul's shared melancholy, as Orhan Pamuk describes it: beauty with weight.

Traits: Black-and-white city, fog on the Bosphorus, faded wooden mansions, ferries at dusk.

Look up: Pamuk's Istanbul: Memories and the City, Ara Güler photographs

## Keyif

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: everyday
- Palette: #b33a2c, #e9c46a, #3d6b4f, #f2ead8
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#keyif

Unhurried pleasure: tea, a view, nowhere to be.

Traits: Tea glass, sunlight, shade under a plane tree, slow time.

Look up: Çay bahçesi, Turkish tea culture

## Early Republic modernism

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 1923–1950
- Palette: #c9b79a, #7e8b8e, #f0ebe0, #a3402f
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#early-republic-modernism

A new nation builds itself in clean geometry and Ankara stone.

Traits: Stripped classicism, flat roofs, new institutions, the alphabet reform.

Look up: Clemens Holzmeister in Ankara, Bruno Taut, Seyfi Arkan

## Republican commercial art

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 1920s–1960s
- Palette: #d1442f, #1f4e79, #e9d9b5, #1a1a1a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#republican-commercial-art

Hand-drawn ads and posters for a modernising country.

Traits: Flat illustration, confident lettering, warm limited inks.

Look up: İhap Hulusi Görey, Münif Fehim

## Turkish modern graphic design

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 1960s–1980s
- Palette: #e63b2e, #111111, #f2f0ea, #2364aa
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#turkish-modern-graphic-design

Bold typographic posters and book covers from a new generation.

Traits: Strong type, geometric abstraction, limited colour, Swiss influence with local motifs.

Look up: Mengü Ertel, Yurdaer Altıntaş, Sait Maden, Bülent Erkmen

## Folk modernism

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 1940s–1970s
- Palette: #c0392b, #2a6f97, #e1b12c, #f5efe0
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#folk-modernism

Painters fold Anatolian motifs into modern art.

Traits: Folk patterns, mosaics, flattened forms, rich colour.

Look up: Bedri Rahmi Eyüboğlu, Group D, Abidin Dino, Fahrelnissa Zeid

## Yeşilçam posters

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Era & style
- Era: 1950s–1980s
- Palette: #d62828, #f77f00, #003049, #fcbf49
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#yesilcam-posters

Hand-painted cinema posters: big faces, big feelings.

Traits: Saturated paint, hand lettering, melodrama, dramatic light.

Look up: Yeşilçam film poster painters

## Bosphorus everyday

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Era & style
- Era: 20th c.–today
- Palette: #f4f4f2, #111111, #b3261e, #3c6e91
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#bosphorus-everyday

The design of ordinary Istanbul: ferries, tea glasses, simit carts, cobblestones.

Traits: White ferries with black funnels, tulip-shaped tea glass, sea light.

Look up: Şehir Hatları ferries, ince belli çay bardağı, Ara Güler

## Anatolian folk objects

- Region: Türkiye & Anatolia
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: centuries–today
- Palette: #1d4e9e, #b87333, #f2ede4, #2ea3d6
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#anatolian-folk-objects

Things made to be used and loved: copper, blue glass, painted ceramics.

Traits: Hammered copper, nazar blue, Beykoz çeşm-i bülbül glass, Kütahya ceramics.

Look up: Nazar boncuğu, Beykoz glass, Kütahya çini

## Wabi-sabi

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: 15th c.–today
- Palette: #7a6a58, #b8a88f, #3e3a33, #e3dccf
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#wabi-sabi

Beauty in the imperfect, impermanent and incomplete.

Traits: Rough clay, patina, asymmetry, quiet colour, signs of age.

Look up: Leonard Koren, Raku tea bowls, Sen no Rikyū

## Ma

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: centuries–today
- Palette: #f2efe9, #1d1d1b, #a39e93, #c2b49a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ma

Meaningful empty space: the pause that gives shape to what surrounds it.

Traits: Interval, silence, emptiness as a material, timing.

Look up: Arata Isozaki's Ma exhibition, the Noh stage

## Shibui

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: Edo–today
- Palette: #5f6b5a, #8e7d68, #d8d2c4, #2f3133
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#shibui

Beauty that is subtle and unobtrusive, and gets richer the longer you look.

Traits: Muted colour with one quiet depth, simple form, fine texture.

Look up: Yanagi Sōetsu

## Yūgen

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: medieval–today
- Palette: #3a4250, #8a919c, #cfd3d6, #1b1e24
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#yugen

A deep, mysterious grace, felt more than seen.

Traits: Mist, dusk, half-seen forms, suggestion over statement.

Look up: Zeami and Noh, Hasegawa Tōhaku's Pine Trees

## In Praise of Shadows

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Aesthetic idea
- Era: 1933
- Palette: #0e0b09, #6b1f16, #c9a14a, #e9e2d4
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#in-praise-of-shadows

Tanizaki's essay: Japanese beauty lives in dim light, lacquer and paper.

Traits: Darkness, gold glinting in shadow, lacquer, translucent shoji, candlelight.

Look up: Jun'ichirō Tanizaki, urushi lacquer

## Ukiyo-e

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 17th–19th c.
- Palette: #1f3d6b, #d8c39b, #b4442f, #f0e7d5
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ukiyo-e

Woodblock prints of the floating world: waves, actors, landscapes.

Traits: Flat colour, strong outline, Prussian blue, bold diagonals.

Look up: Hokusai's Great Wave, Hiroshige, Utamaro

## Rinpa

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 17th–19th c.
- Palette: #c9a54a, #2d4f8b, #4e7d3a, #111111
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#rinpa

Decorative painting with gold leaf, bold shapes and nature in close-up.

Traits: Gold and silver grounds, irises, waves, pooled ink.

Look up: Ogata Kōrin's Irises, Tawaraya Sōtatsu's Wind and Thunder Gods

## Sumi-e

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 14th c.–today
- Palette: #111111, #5a5a5a, #a8a8a8, #f3f1ec
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#sumi-e

One brush, one ink, many greys: mountains and pines in mist.

Traits: Ink wash, white space, single strokes, gradients of black.

Look up: Sesshū, Hasegawa Tōhaku

## Mingei

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 1920s–today
- Palette: #2e3f5c, #8b5a3c, #d9cbb2, #4a4a3f
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#mingei

Folk craft: honest, useful objects made by unknown hands.

Traits: Stoneware, indigo, wood, natural glazes, repetition, use.

Look up: Yanagi Sōetsu, Hamada Shōji, Bernard Leach

## Sukiya & the tea house

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 16th c.–today
- Palette: #b89b72, #e8e0cf, #5c6e4a, #2f2a24
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#sukiya-and-the-tea-house

Rustic refinement: thin timber, paper screens, gardens framed like paintings.

Traits: Unpainted wood, tatami, shoji, the tokonoma alcove, borrowed scenery.

Look up: Katsura Imperial Villa, Tai-an tea room

## Yakisugi

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 18th c.–today
- Palette: #121212, #3a3a38, #8a8478, #c8b89a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#yakisugi

Charred cedar cladding: wood protected by fire, black and silver.

Traits: Alligator-skin char, black timber, weathering, deep texture.

Look up: Shou sugi ban, Terunobu Fujimori

## Kamon

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 12th c.–today
- Palette: #111111, #f4f1ea, #7d1e1e, #b0a58f
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#kamon

Family crests: thousands of circular emblems drawn from plants and objects.

Traits: Circles, strict symmetry, one colour, stylised nature.

Look up: Japanese family crests

## Shibori & aizome

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 8th c.–today
- Palette: #1b2a4a, #3e5c8a, #9db4cf, #eef1f4
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#shibori-and-aizome

Indigo dye and resist techniques that make soft, rhythmic patterns.

Traits: Indigo from pale to near-black, folded and bound patterns.

Look up: Arimatsu shibori, boro

## Kintsugi

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 15th c.–today
- Palette: #c9a14a, #2d2a26, #8a7e6e, #ece6da
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#kintsugi

Broken pottery mended with gold, so the repair becomes the beauty.

Traits: Gold seams, cracked ceramic, honest history.

Look up: Urushi repair

## Japanese modern graphics

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 1950s–1970s
- Palette: #d7262e, #111111, #f3f1ec, #1c4a8c
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#japanese-modern-graphics

Modernist posters with a Japanese sense of space and symbol.

Traits: Bold geometric form, the red circle, photography, big empty fields.

Look up: Yusaku Kamekura's Tokyo 1964 posters, Ikko Tanaka, Tadanori Yokoo

## Muji emptiness

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Graphic & type
- Era: 1980s–today
- Palette: #f5f3ee, #c9bfae, #8c8478, #2b2b2b
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#muji-emptiness

Design that steps back so the user can step in.

Traits: White and raw materials, no logos, plain type, emptiness as a promise.

Look up: Kenya Hara, Naoto Fukasawa

## Metabolism

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Architecture
- Era: 1959–1970s
- Palette: #8f9295, #d6d4cf, #3b3d40, #c9502a
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#metabolism

Cities as living organisms: modular capsules and megastructures.

Traits: Concrete cores, plug-in capsules, grand scale, optimism.

Look up: Nakagin Capsule Tower, Kenzo Tange, Expo 70

## Superflat

- Region: Japan
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 2000s
- Palette: #ef476f, #ffd166, #06d6a0, #118ab2
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#superflat

Anime, ukiyo-e and pop flattened into one bright surface.

Traits: Flat colour, no depth, cute and uncanny, dense pattern.

Look up: Takashi Murakami

## Shan shui

- Region: China & Korea
- Kind: Movement
- Era: 10th c.–today
- Palette: #2a2a28, #6f726e, #b9b8b0, #efece4
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#shan-shui

Mountains and water in mist: a landscape you wander through with your eyes.

Traits: Ink, vertical scrolls, layered distance, tiny human figures.

Look up: Guo Xi's Early Spring, Fan Kuan's Travelers

## Song ceramics

- Region: China & Korea
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 960–1279
- Palette: #a9c2b8, #cfd8cf, #7f9a8f, #e8e6dc
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#song-ceramics

Glazes so quiet they look like sky, jade or moonlight.

Traits: Celadon, Ru ware sky blue, crackle, pure form.

Look up: Ru ware, Longquan celadon, Jun ware

## Ming furniture

- Region: China & Korea
- Kind: Craft & material
- Era: 1368–1644
- Palette: #8a4f2b, #c08a5a, #3a2418, #ece0cc
- Link: https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/#ming-furniture

Scholar's furniture in rare hardwood: lean lines, no nails, perfect joinery.
